variant_config.skill_bodies: 11 designated skills from variants/body/<name>/SKILL.md; all others from plugins/mochiko/skills/<name>/SKILL.md

body_skills_not_fired.authoring-requirements: specify-run skill, not a setup seat

deviations.deviation: Interrogation batched ~2 agenda dimensions per principal spawn (6 spawns total) instead of strict one-question-per-turn.
deviations.justification: The single-agent simulation answers the principal only via fresh subagent spawns; the RUN-PROTOCOL explicitly spawns 'a fresh principal subagent per question batch'. Batching bounds spawn count while preserving adaptive coverage. All ten dimensions plus the full deck were worked.
deviations.impact: None on artifact content; affects only dialogue granularity in transcript.md.

deviations.deviation: Cold intent review was performed by the run-lead itself (body loaded, blind angle map built from topic alone, findings produced strictly from the artifact text), not by a separately spawned reviewer; and the default review sizing was 'pair' but executed solo.
deviations.justification: Per the RUN-PROTOCOL single-agent model, the run-lead plays every seat and honors author!=grader by producing grader output strictly from artifact text. The synthesis Review section records the pair->solo reduction as a simulation constraint. (The Tier-2 constitution validation WAS run as fresh independent subagents, since author!=grader is load-bearing there.)
deviations.impact: Reduced adversarial independence on the intent review vs a real two-reviewer pair; noted so scoring can weigh it.

deviations.deviation: testing-governance-injection body was loaded and the invocation decided, but the empirical injection probe was NOT executed.
deviations.justification: The probe requires the project to be the harness's active rules root; the benchmark sandbox (runs/setup-body-r1/project/) is not, so a real Write-then-Read injection probe would produce a false result. Deferred to BACKLOG as a re-runnable standalone finalize offer.
deviations.impact: Empirical rules-delivery is unverified for this run (static validation PASSED); recorded, not silently skipped.

deviations.deviation: Plan-approval gate for producing seats was self-approved by the run-lead.
deviations.justification: Single-agent simulation — the lead is the only actor and the command names the lead as plan approver for the run.
